summary: The PR addresses the issue of duplicate yields in the post_process method of HashedFilesMixin, improving the accuracy of post-processing statistics and reducing unnecessary work in subclasses.

issues.description: The use of a dictionary to store processed adjustable paths could be improved for clarity. A more descriptive variable name and possibly a comment explaining the purpose of the dictionary would enhance readability.

The PR does not include any additional documentation or comments to explain the changes made to the post_process method. Adding a brief explanation in the method's docstring or inline comments would help future maintainers understand the logic.
